from glom.core import Let, Coalesce, Inspect, Call, Path, Spec

# Test various reprs
print('Let:', repr(Let(a='b')))
print('Coalesce:', repr(Coalesce(1, 2)))
print('Inspect:', repr(Inspect(lambda x: x)))
print('Call:', repr(Call('foo')))
print('Path:', repr(Path('a', '.', 'b')))
print('Spec:', repr(Spec('x')))
"
